# Ashok Home Furnishing (D'Decor Vellore)

> Ashok Home Furnishing is the only authorized D'Decor dealer in Vellore, Tamil Nadu. It sells and fits custom curtains, blinds, wallpapers, sofas, mattresses, headboards, carpets and wooden flooring, and offers free site visits in Vellore, Katpadi and nearby areas.

## Key facts
- Showroom 1 (experience centre): 85/10 A, Anna Nagar, opposite Balaji Honda, NH-48, Perumugai, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632009
- Showroom 2 (city branch): No. 6, Old Bypass Road, opposite Surana Hardware, Thottapalayam, Fort, Vellore 632004
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99944 41234, +91 95972 09255
- Hours: 10 am to 8:30 pm
- Ratings: 4.8 on Google (42 reviews), 5.0 on Justdial (129+ reviews)
- Homes furnished: 100+ in and around Vellore
